clue.text: Great at organising water sports

indicators.note: organising means arranging the letters of the words before it into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone excels at arranging aquatic events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organising' rearranges GREATAT, the letters of 'Great at'.
explanation.definitionFit: A regatta is a meeting of boat races, a festival of rowing and sailing on the water.

clue.text: Not a well cooked portion of savoury

parts.note: meat that is not well done is underdone or rare
a portion is a bit

explanation.surface: Someone is served an underdone helping of a savoury dish.
explanation.walkthrough: Welsh rarebit is cheese on toast, a classic British savoury.
explanation.definitionFit: Welsh rarebit, melted cheese on toast, is a traditional British savoury course.

clue.text: Vessel that shoots over the waves

definitions.text: Vessel that shoots over the waves

parts.words: Vessel that shoots over the waves
parts.note: suggests a fast boat skimming the sea, but means a ship armed to fire its weapons across the water

explanation.definitionFit: A small warship carrying artillery fires across the sea at its targets.

clue.text: Some Spartans return with snares

indicators.note: return means that run of letters is read backwards
some of the word Spartans is taken, a run of letters inside it

explanation.surface: A few ancient Greek warriors come back home carrying snares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes SPART from Spartans; 'return' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Traps and snares are both devices for catching animals.

clue.text: A great man in history

parts.note: reads as any important historical figure, but points to the Macedonian king whose title was 'the Great'

explanation.definitionFit: The Macedonian conqueror known as 'the Great' is a famous figure of ancient history.

clue.text: New issue stamp on letter is entrusted to him

indicators.note: a new issue gives the words stamp on a fresh arrangement of their letters

explanation.surface: A freshly issued stamp goes on a letter handed to the mail carrier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New issue' rearranges the letters of 'stamp on'.
explanation.definitionFit: The mail carrier is the person to whom letters are given for delivery.

clue.text: Part of flower-plate design

indicators.note: design suggests the letters of plate are worked into a new pattern

explanation.surface: Part of a floral pattern on a dinner plate.
explanation.definitionFit: Petals are the coloured leaf-like segments of a bloom.

clue.text: Is noticeably not flush?

explanation.definitionFit: To be prominent is to be conspicuous; physically, something protruding is not level with the surface around it.

clue.text: Marconi's resort?

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort means the letters of the inventor's name are sorted again

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Where might the radio pioneer have gone on holiday?
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' read as re-sort rearranges MARCONI, while the whole clue names a Spanish holiday island.
explanation.definitionFit: The Balearic island is a popular Mediterranean holiday destination.

clue.text: Where children may go between two and five

definitions.text: Where children may go between two and five

parts.words: Where children may go between two and five
parts.note: sounds like a time of day, but means the ages of small children before school

explanation.definitionFit: Children aged roughly two to five attend preschool classes.

clue.text: Manage valley by a system of holding land

parts.note: to manage a business is to run it
a dale is a valley, especially in northern England

explanation.surface: Running a valley under an old land tenure scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: Rundale was an old Irish and Scottish system of scattered strips of land held in common.
explanation.definitionFit: Rundale was a traditional Irish and Scottish arrangement of scattered strips worked jointly by tenants.

clue.text: Wrong terrain for a coach

indicators.note: wrong means the letters of terrain are put in a mistaken order

explanation.surface: An unsuitable surface for a coach to drive on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wrong' rearranges the letters of 'terrain'. 'coach' looks like a bus; it is a sports instructor.
explanation.definitionFit: A coach in sport is an instructor who prepares athletes.

clue.text: Reserves high place for publications

parts.note: to reserve seats is to book them
high means tall

explanation.surface: Someone books a lofty spot for selling magazines.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand or kiosk selling books and newspapers is a place to buy printed matter.

clue.text: An air of sadness

parts.note: reads as a gloomy mood but means a mournful tune

explanation.definitionFit: A dirge is a slow mournful song, a lament for the dead.

clue.text: Not qualified to give the final figure

explanation.definitionFit: Complete or absolute means without qualification; the sum reached at the end of adding is the overall figure.

clue.text: It cuts down the light coming from headlamps

indicators.note: coming from says the answer is produced out of the letters of headlamps, rearranged

explanation.surface: Something dims the glare from a car's lights.
explanation.definitionFit: A shade over a bulb softens and reduces the glare it gives off.

clue.text: It may help to rescue a country from mad policy

definitions.text: It may help to rescue a country

indicators.note: from says the answer is made out of the letters of mad policy, rearranged

explanation.surface: Tact may save a nation from a crazy strategy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' rearranges the letters of 'mad policy'; 'mad' also hints at the scrambling.
explanation.definitionFit: Skilful negotiation between states can rescue a nation from a crisis.

clue.text: Not a driver to overtake on green, perhaps

parts.note: to overtake another car is to pass it

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters of green may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: Someone tells a motorist not to overtake on a green light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges the letters of 'green' to ENGER.
explanation.definitionFit: A traveller in a car who is carried rather than at the wheel.

clue.text: Well-rounded notes in an unbeatable score

parts.note: well-rounded can mean plump or full
marks are notes or signs made on something

explanation.surface: A balanced set of musical notes earns a perfect result.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting every point available is the maximum possible result.

clue.text: A vital point when it comes to a purchase

definitions.text: A vital point when it comes to a purchase

parts.words: A vital point when it comes to a purchase
parts.note: seems to be about shopping, but purchase here means leverage, and the point is a lever's pivot

explanation.definitionFit: The pivot on which a lever turns is essential to gaining mechanical grip.

clue.text: Restricted cover includes free time

indicators.note: includes means the cover word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a lid is a cover

indicators.note: free means the letters of time are set loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: Restricted insurance cover takes in some free time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' is the anagram signal on time, and 'includes' is the container signal; 'cover' looks like insurance but is a pot's top.
explanation.definitionFit: Something limited is restricted or kept within bounds.

clue.text: Tony's knocked out by infamous world champion

indicators.note: knocked out means the letters of Tony's are knocked into a different order

explanation.surface: Tony is floored by a notorious boxer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked out' rearranges TONYS. Mike Tyson is the heavyweight boxing champion with a notorious criminal record.
explanation.definitionFit: Mike Tyson was world heavyweight boxing champion, notorious for biting an opponent and a criminal conviction.

clue.text: Cut some grain in an outhouse

indicators.note: in means the grain word goes inside the outhouse word

parts.note: a shed is an outhouse
an ear is the grain-bearing head of a cereal plant

explanation.surface: Someone chops up some grain stored in a farm building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal; an ear is the head of a cereal plant holding its grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheared is the past tense of shear, to clip or cut.

clue.text: Annoys with stinging words?

explanation.definitionFit: To nettle is to irritate; the stinging weeds are named by the same word, here whimsically as words that sting.

clue.text: Fifty-one doctors appear to be members

parts.note: LI is the Roman numeral for fifty-one
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's degree, so doctors are MBs

explanation.surface: Fifty-one physicians turn out to be on the register.
explanation.definitionFit: Arms and legs are the body's members.

clue.text: Head of state needs trip abroad

indicators.note: abroad means the letters of needs trip are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A national leader has to travel overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: A president is the elected leader of a republic.

clue.text: The Fleet Street crowd

explanation.walkthrough: Fleet Street is the London street once home to the national newspapers.
explanation.definitionFit: Fleet Street in London was home to Britain's newspapers, so it stands for journalists; a throng of people is also a crush.

clue.text: Victor, out West, is a pretty good shot

indicators.note: out means the letter for West is removed

parts.note: a victor is a winner

explanation.surface: A champion out in the West shows himself a fine marksman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' removes W from WINNER. The inner is the ring next to the bullseye on a target.
explanation.definitionFit: On a target, the ring just outside the bullseye scores well but not best.

clue.text: Desert folk struggle to succeed

parts.note: to rat is to desert or betray
a race is a people or folk

explanation.surface: Nomads of the desert fight to get ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: The rat race is the competitive scramble for success at work.

clue.text: Officer in uniform or overall

explanation.definitionFit: A senior army commander wears uniform; as an adjective the word means broad or across the board.

clue.text: Infuriates with fresh demands

indicators.note: fresh suggests the letters of demands are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: New requests make someone furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To madden is to enrage or drive someone wild with anger.

clue.text: Screen has red centre and unusual rose edging

indicators.note: edging means the rearranged letters form a border around red, which sits at the centre
unusual means the letters of rose appear in an odd order

explanation.surface: A partition has a red middle with a strange rose-coloured border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' gives REOS; 'edging' puts it around red, and 'centre' just stresses that red sits in the middle. A reredos is a screen behind a church altar.
explanation.definitionFit: A reredos is an ornamental partition behind a church altar.
